title: Magnificent Bat Pelt
flavorText: Though too small to make anything larger than a pillow from it, the pelt of this bat is silky soft and well-groomed.
name: Magnificent Bat Pelt

title: Shimmering Alit Bezoar
flavorText: This stone was pulled from the gullet of a slain alit.
name: Shimmering Alit Bezoar

title: Gnarled Bear Claw
flavorText: The paw of this bear is tipped with brutal, jagged claws that could tear the face off a grown man.
name: Gnarled Bear Claw

title: Wolf's Tooth Necklace
flavorText: The large canine of a wolf makes an excellent, easily made souvenir with but a simple leather string.
name: Wolf's Tooth Necklace

title: Cat's Claw
flavorText: This hooked, retractable talon is a token of victory over a savage big cat.
name: Cat's Claw

title: Inert Egg
flavorText: The giant snake swallowed a huge, mottled egg. The egg is still warm, but shows no signs of hatching.
name: Inert Egg

title: Malformed Kagouti Tusk
flavorText: This tooth curls in on itself like a seashell and is highly polished by saliva and other digestive fluids.
name: Malformed Kagouti Tusk

title: Gauntlets of the Willow's Path
name: Gauntlets of the Willow's Path

title: Huge Mammoth's Tooth
flavorText: While a mammoth's tusks are impressive, the creature's eye teeth truly show its age and size.
name: Huge Mammoth's Tooth

title: Buzzing Spine
flavorText: This spine from a wamasu's ridge hums faintly and causes unprotected flesh to tingle unpleasantly.
name: Buzzing Spine

title: Bile Gilt
flavorText: Netch organs typically produce paralyzing venom, but this one has hardened into a pearl-like stone.
name: Bile Gilt

title: Cruel Collar
flavorText: This barbed collar was around the neck of a slain jackal. Clearly someone tried to make it a pet.
name: Cruel Collar

title: Hand of Glory
flavorText: The practice of cutting off the hands of hanged murderers appears to be alive and well in Tamriel.
name: Hand of Glory

title: Chattering Skull
flavorText: Even after its body was destroyed, this skeleton's jaw keeps moving, seemingly of its own accord.
name: Chattering Skull

title: Wraith Shackle
flavorText: This ghostly chain did not dissipate upon destruction of the wraith that bore it.
name: Wraith Shackle

title: Crypt Jar
flavorText: The embalmed dead from many cultures in Tamriel often have their organs stored in separate containers.
name: Crypt Jar

title: Twitching Draugr Hand
flavorText: The Nord dead can rise to protect their tombs and even dismemberment does not always stop this drive.
name: Twitching Draugr Hand

title: Ectoplasmic Discharge
flavorText: This variety of the common residue isn't useful, but glows softly within its vial and casts an eerie greenish light.
name: Ectoplasmic Discharge

title: Petrified Spider Egg
flavorText: A tiny spider is forever frozen within the calcified confines of this egg.
name: Petrified Spider Egg

title: Calcified Cuttle
flavorText: The cuttle from the beak of the kwama sometimes hardens and crystallizes, appearing much like quartz.
name: Calcified Cuttle

title: Razor-Edged Mandible
flavorText: Though the chitin is dried and the edges are brittle, the blade-like jaws of the giant beetle are still impressive.
name: Razor-Edged Mandible

title: Luminous Blood Sac
flavorText: The blood sac of this hoarvor is filled with glowing blood. Whatever it feasted upon was unnatural indeed.
name: Luminous Blood Sac

title: Polished Shell Shard
flavorText: Water flowing over the shell of the mudcrab has polished it to a pearly sheen.
name: Polished Shell Shard

title: Prized Barb
flavorText: While useless as a weapon now that its owner is dead, the mottled coloration and fearsome nature of the object is impressive.
name: Prized Barb

title: Multifaceted Eye
flavorText: A thousand reflections of yourself can be seen when this eye is held up for inspection.
name: Multifaceted Eye

title: Gossamer Winglet
flavorText: The second row of wings on a wasp's back are of a paper-like consistency and refract light in a pleasing way.
name: Gossamer Winglet

title: Perfectly Balanced Gyro
flavorText: Even when set down on its sides or tossed gently across the floor, this component rights itself and continues to spin.
name: Perfectly Balanced Gyro

title: Whirring Dynamo
flavorText: This dynamo taken from a mechanical spider continues to buzz and hum despite its owner being little more than scrap.
name: Whirring Dynamo

title: Primal Sproutling
flavorText: Found lodged in the side of the spriggan's corpse is a cutting, an innocent bloom fallen away from the nature spirit.
name: Primal Sproutling

title: Lashing Tentacle
flavorText: Despite being severed from its fleshy trunk, the tentacle of the strangler plant continues to writhe and ooze without tiring.
name: Lashing Tentacle

title: Brass Anklets
flavorText: Claimed from a slain Nereid, these shining brass anklets should have corroded away long ago, but they remain intact.
name: Brass Anklets

title: Imp's Effigy
flavorText: Why the imp was carrying a small wicker caricature is unknown, but the effigy is unnerving to stare at for long.
name: Imp's Effigy

title: Icebound Vertebra
flavorText: The frozen spine of the Ice Wraith shattered when it died, but one of its smaller vertebrae survived.
name: Icebound Vertebra

title: Knotted Heart
flavorText: Pulled from the torso of a slain lurcher, this fist-sized acorn beats like a heart.
name: Knotted Heart

title: Glowing Remnant
flavorText: When held up to the ear, a soft sound like that of a distant sob can be heard.
name: Glowing Remnant

title: Werewolf's Cameo
flavorText: The image on the profile is that of a young woman, but when held up to moonlight, it changes to that of a wolf.
name: Werewolf's Cameo

title: Nose Shackle
flavorText: This trophy from a slain ogrim is etched with jagged runes, signifying its obeisance to a Daedric master.
name: Nose Shackle

title: Troll Skull
flavorText: Troll skulls are macabre, sought-after collectibles across Tamriel.
name: Troll Skull

title: Ogre Toe Ring
flavorText: Not known for wearing jewelry, it's surprising that this Ogre wore a massive toe-ring on its right foot.
name: Ogre Toe Ring

title: Stony Heart
flavorText: Striated with multi-hued crystal, the head-sized core of the slain gargoyle stretches the definition of the word "heart."
name: Stony Heart

title: Second Skin
flavorText: The fine, translucent sheaf of epidermis acts like a prism when held up to the light, refracting colors in all directions.
name: Second Skin

title: Flawless Tail Feather
flavorText: Harpy plumage is generally beautiful, but this feather stands out above all others.
name: Flawless Tail Feather

title: Smoldering Ember Heart
flavorText: For whatever reason, the heart of this flame atronach has refused to cool entirely and is very warm to the touch.
name: Smoldering Ember Heart

title: Fleshy Symbiont
flavorText: Though the rest of the atronach has become inert, the lashing, slavering tongue of your kill continues to twitch and undulate.
name: Fleshy Symbiont

title: Everfrost
flavorText: Though most of a frost atronach's remains will melt and sublimate eventually, this shard of its body persists.
name: Everfrost

title: Crackling Lodestone
flavorText: This lodestone was pulled from the remains of a storm atronach and has yet to cease sparking.
name: Crackling Lodestone

title: Banekin Horn
flavorText: Despite the discorporation process that follows the destruction of Daedra, the gnarled and tumorous horn of the banekin endures.
name: Banekin Horn

title: Daedric Dewclaw
flavorText: Clannfear claws are made for hooking their prey and pinning them while they are consumed alive.
name: Daedric Dewclaw

title: Burning Daedroth Eye
flavorText: Even after its host was slain, this hateful eye stares malevolently back at you, its humors failing to calcify or drain away.
name: Burning Daedroth Eye

title: Blighted Iron Collar
flavorText: This Scamp's iron collar is etched with runes ascribing it as the property of one of the innumerable Dremora Kynreeves.
name: Blighted Iron Collar

title: Spider's Crown
flavorText: The exoskeletal ridge affixed to the Daedra's brow broke away when she died, appearing much like a chitinous crown.
name: Spider's Crown

title: Whisperwoe
enchantDescription: Deals |cffffff0|r Poison Damage.
name: Whisperwoe
